text:
Sam: Whos up for a tiny Saturday micro-adventure? rooftop movie at my place, DIY terrarium workshop at Lenas, or late-night ramen crawl? low-key, pick one.
Lena: Ooh terrarium sounds fun  I have jars + soil and tiny succulents. midday would be best for me (sunlight for plants).
Ivy: Im out for terrariums (also I can bring moss and tiny figurines). movie rooftop also tempting though.
Rohit: Ramen crawl please  Im hungry every hour. can do late night and scout the best spots.
Sam: Quick poll with emoji: :film_projector: rooftop movie, :herb: terrarium, :ramen: ramen crawl.
Lena: :herb: :herb: two terrarium votes.
Ivy: :herb: one more terrarium.
Rohit: :ramen: ramen all the way.
Sam: :film_projector: one rooftop vote.
EventBot: poll closed: terrarium (3), rooftop movie (1), ramen crawl (1). Suggested schedule: Terrarium Workshop Sat 2026-11-14 11:00 AM PST at Lenas.
Lena: Yay! I can host around 11, well have a short demo then free-build. bring a jar if you have a funky one, otherwise Ill have extras.
Sam: Ill bring small pebbles and a tiny funnel (makes filling jars less messy). also can bring coffee.
Ivy: Ill bring extra moss and a tiny plastic dinosaur for the kits. :dinosaur:
Rohit: Ill bring snacks and tea. and a camera for before/after pics.
Lena: Tiny supplies checklist in case useful: jars or clear containers, potting soil, activated charcoal (optional), small pebbles, sphagnum moss, succulents or air plants, tweezers, spray bottle.
Sam: Also please label plant types if youre lending a cutting. some people are allergic to certain species.
Ivy: Ill label mine and include care notes. also planning a 30-min crash course on moss placement.
Rohit: If anyone wants to do the rooftop movie afterwards were welcome to move to Sams at 6pm for drinks and a short film screening. adds flexibility.
Sam: Yup rooftop is open after 6, bring a sweater and a blanket. small projector and HDMI cable available.
EventBot: Calendar event created: "Terrarium Workshop @ Lena's" Sat 2026-11-14 11:00 PST  attendees: Sam, Lena, Ivy, Rohit  https://calendar.example/evt/321654
Lena: Payment-ish note: if you want a premium kit (extra succulents + clay tools) Ill have a few for $10 to cover materials. cash or venmo ok.
Ivy: Ill take one premium kit if available.
Rohit: Same here. can bring exact change.
Sam: Cool. If you need jars before Saturday I have two vintage jam jars you can borrow  lmk.
Lena: Awesome. See you Saturday morning! tiny reminder: wear something you dont mind getting a bit of soil on. :seedling:
Ivy: Excited! see yall  also will bring a playlist link: https://example.com/playlist/craft-sunday
Rohit: Looking forward to plant babies and maybe a rooftop flick later. :raised_hands:
Sam: Final note  parking near Lenas is limited; consider carpool or street parking on Oak. map: https://maps.example/lenas-place
Lena: Ill pin the exact spot in the event. thanks everyone!
EventBot: Reminder scheduled: 24 hours before event.
